title: Set up monitoring on a component
description: Add a reachability probe and attach the SNMP driver to a component, both collected by an edge node, and watch reachability and samples arrive.

steps.caption: A display mounted in Bay 2. Nothing collects from it yet, so Omniglass knows nothing of its health.
Endpoints are how a component is reached; they live under Configure.
First a probe, for one question: can the node reach it?
The node edge-hq sits on the display's network, so it runs the check.
An ICMP probe pings the display's address.
Create it. Its reachability task derives on its own.
The endpoint is placed. Close it; next, what the display itself reports.
A second endpoint, this time from a driver.
A driver knows how to talk to a product, and what to read from it.
The SNMP driver reads standard device data, such as uptime.
You supply only its inputs. The host is the display's address.
The community is a secret's name, never its value.
The driver derived the endpoint, its SNMP transport and its polling.
Back on the display's page, a few seconds on.
Reachability and samples arrived. The ping answers, and the simulated display reports its uptime over SNMP.
